events.title: Uncontrollable + patrol AI
events.description: SelectionSystem.BoxSelect now skips NotControllableTag entities so drag-select can't grab Raiders (single click-inspect still permitted via IsSelectableByPlayer for HUD readout). CommandRouter's existing IsBlockedByNotControllable gates direct commands. New Systems/AI/FeraldisRaiderPatrolSystem retargets every 1.5 s: scans all faction-tagged entities with health, finds nearest non-self-faction live target within 200 units, sets DesiredDestination + Target on each FeraldisRaiderTag entity.
